sources.title: e-Visa Tchad: current visa-exemption list and online-only visa notice
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration / e-Visa Subdirectorate
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official evisa.td platform identifies the Directorate of Immigration and Emigration and E-Visa Subdirectorate, publishes its 11 May 2026 notice, and displays the current entry-visa exemption list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Si vous êtes un ressortissant d'un des pays figurant dans la liste ... vous êtes exempté de visa.

sources.title: CEMAC: Member States
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: CEMAC’s official Commission website identifies the six current member States, allowing Chad’s five foreign Member-State ordinary-passport codes to be mapped.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Cameroun, le Congo, le Gabon, la Guinée Équatoriale, la République de Centrafrique et le Tchad.

sources.title: CEMAC Commission President interview on free movement
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current CEMAC Commission account directly says visa-free free movement for Member-State citizens is effective.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L’effectivité de la libre circulation des citoyens des pays membres de la CEMAC, sans visa, est une réalité indéniable.

sources.title: Common Convention on free movement and right of establishment
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: CEMAC publishes the Common Convention in its official legal archive. Its free-movement provisions cover Union Member-State nationals travelling as tourists and specify document and three-month conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La libre circulation de ces personnes comporte le droit de se déplacer et de séjourner ... pendant une durée de 3 mois

policies.title: Current named ordinary passports: Chad visa-free entry
policies.summary: The live official eVisa service expressly lists these 21 passport issuers as exempt from an entry visa. The CEMAC sources independently corroborate the five foreign CEMAC members within that list; no residual eVisa or visa-required route is inferred.
conditions: The official eVisa page displays this exact named exemption list. It does not state an ordinary-versus-special-passport distinction, stay period, purpose, effective date, port or underlying bilateral instrument; the ordinary-passport mapping is therefore medium confidence.

For Cameroon, the Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea and the Central African Republic, current CEMAC material separately confirms visa-free free movement. The Convention describes tourist movement up to three months with a valid/recently-expired national identity card or passport and an international health booklet.

The official portal says all new visa applications are online as of 11 May 2026, but a generic application workflow does not prove a route for any unlisted passport. The inaccessible 2025 Official Journal PDF was not relied upon for a residual default.
Border, public-health, security, individual-admissibility, work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee and special-document rules remain separate.
